summary: Vendor payout tracking and admin payment management feature testing complete. All 15 new backend payout endpoints passing (100%). Frontend UI fully functional: Vendor Dashboard now has 3 tabs (Drops/Orders/Earnings) with earnings summary cards and commission display. Admin Panel now has 2 tabs (Vendors/Payments) with vendor payout list, Mark as Paid form, and payout history. Commission calculation verified at 15% of discounted_price × quantity for picked_up orders only.

✅ Admin Panel has 2 tabs: Vendors, Payments
